title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're excited to announce that Spyglass has officially launched, providing powerful new capabilities to help you gain deeper understanding.

title: Master Your Media: Enhanced File Management & Display
summary: Take full command of your content with new, intuitive tools that allow you to effortlessly manage, customize, and display all your images and files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new interactive public roadmap to track our progress, discover upcoming features, and peek at what we're planning for the future.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: We've made your task management smoother with newly enhanced checkboxes that are now easier to click, visually consistent, and fully draggable for effortless organization.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've made working together more intuitive and effortless with upgraded real-time collaboration features and clearer syncing indicators.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Sharing
summary: Now you can effortlessly find and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, making teamwork more visible and effective than ever before.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: We're thrilled to open-source Noeko's codebase, empowering our community with maximum control, transparent development, and the opportunity to directly contribute to its exciting future.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons to welcome users everywhere with robust support for a diverse range of global languages.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: Immerse yourself in a refreshed visual experience as we perfect existing themes and unveil a stunning array of new designs for your ultimate personalization.

title: Dynamic Constellation View
summary: Explore your knowledge base like never before with new filtering by tags and time, alongside enhanced visibility into shared items and collaborators, transforming your Constellation view into a powerful workflow starter.

title: Personalized Knowledge Discovery & Organization
summary: Navigate your knowledge with unprecedented precision, using powerful filters and flexible sorting, and instantly save your perfectly refined searches as custom Compendiums.

title: Adaptive Content Views
summary: Experience a smarter way to structure your notes with adaptive content views that enhance readability and interaction.

title: Flexible Hosting and Enhanced Plans for Noeko
summary: Gain complete control with self-hosted Noeko and unlock powerful features through our new flexible cloud plans designed to grow with your organization.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your welcome experience by ensuring all time-based greetings on the homepage accurately reflect your local time of day, making every visit feel more personal.

title: Enhanced List Actions
summary: Take direct control of your lists with new quick actions to manage items like unapplying tags, deleting, and viewing, all from one convenient place.

title: Unlock More Content Formats
summary: Get ready to seamlessly import information from more sources than ever before, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, making it simpler to consolidate your knowledge.
